target.title: feat: add auth list shortcut
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw models auth list` is the canonical command for inspecting saved model auth profiles, but the shorter top-level shape `openclaw auth list` is still unavailable. This PR adds only that shortcut and keeps the existing model-auth listing implementation as the source of truth.

## Summary

- Add a top-level `openclaw auth list` command.
- Delegate to the existing `modelsAuthListCommand`.
- Preserve `--provider`, `--agent`, and `--json` behaviour.
- Register the lazy top-level `auth` sub-CLI.
- Document the shortcut in the CLI index and models auth docs.

## Scope Boundary

- No new auth storage, login, refresh, secret resolution, or provider probing behaviour.
- No changes to `src/commands/models/auth-list.ts`.
- This does not revive the stale #73462 branch; it is a fresh, narrow alias-only PR.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check` passed.
- Local targeted Vitest did not run: this fresh worktree has no installed dependencies, and dependency verification could not reach npm registry endpoints (`ETIMEDOUT`/`ENOTFOUND`) before Vitest started. The branch is pushed for GitHub CI validation.

## Security Impact

- New permissions/capabilities: No.
- Secrets/tokens handling changed: No.
- New/changed network calls: No.
- Command/tool execution surface changed: Yes, a read-only CLI alias is added.
- Data access scope changed: No.

The alias reuses the existing redacted model auth profile listing command, so raw token/API-key/OAuth material remains hidden by the existing implementation and tests.
